name: verifex-mcp
description: Screen people and companies against sanctions lists and fetch the Evidence Capsule audit record.
long_description: Screens one person or company at a time against the sanctions and watchlists on your Verifex plan, reads back past screenings and retrieves each screening's Evidence Capsule. Every result starts with a status line: a potential match reads "Potential match — review required", zero matches name the lists that were checked, and a screening that could not complete reads "Screening incomplete". Only the name, type, country and date of birth are sent to Verifex. Screenings bill to your existing Verifex plan.
